capabilities: Sync Granola meeting notes and AI summaries into the vault
Write notes to daily-note sections or individual files
Sync transcripts as separate, co-located or combined files
Download and embed meeting photos and screenshots
Run periodic automatic syncs with title-based filters
extras: Desktop only, not supported on mobile. Version 2.1.0 replaced credential-based login with the official Granola API, so upgrading users must create an API key; existing synced files are re-keyed rather than duplicated. The plugin is not affiliated with Granola.
motivation: The author wanted Granola notes to be searchable, linkable and kept by the user instead of locked away in Granola, separate from everything else.
problem: Meeting notes and transcripts stay inside Granola, apart from the rest of a vault, so they cannot be searched, linked or organised alongside other notes.

relations.evidence: pulls your Granola meeting notes and transcripts into your Obsidian vault as plain Markdown

summary: Plugin that pulls Granola meeting notes, AI summaries and transcripts into a vault as Markdown files with configurable folders and filenames.
